_about: The action guard's pack for claude.ai (scripts/guard/guard.mjs), for videos on the owner's REAL Claude account. Logged runs on 13 Nov 2026 (output/guard-learn/claude.ai, explore.mjs --learn) showed claude.ai sending chats through ConversationService RPCs (/claudeai-rpc/...: PerformAction sends, StreamTimeline and GetNewConversationDefaults read) and probing every connected connector on each page load (/v1/toolbox/shttp/mcp/<id>: server/discover, initialize). Every message carries the account's connector tools (SuperX, Whop admin...). What Claude does THROUGH a connector runs on Anthropic's servers, not in this browser, so no guard here can see it; a connector action sent from the page itself (tools/call) is blocked. Billing, plan changes, API keys, members, connector setup, settings, sharing and deleting are blocked; everything else is blocked by default.

ignore.label: how long a page was open (Claude's own usage report)

read_requests.label: reading a conversation and the new-chat defaults
connectors saying what they offer (discover, initialize, list: no action)

dangerous.reason: paying, upgrading or changing the plan (a real charge)
dangerous.note: Card processors (Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Apple Pay...) are blocked for every site in config/guard/_payments.json; these are this site's own ways of paying.

dangerous.reason: changing members, invites or the organisation
adding, removing, authorising or running a connector
changing the account, its profile, memory or settings
sharing or publishing a chat or an artifact

changes.label: starting a chat and sending a prompt to Claude
